proposals.name: 02-context-arc
proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished design proposal for the Cody Companion main Home UI on a circular 466x466 AMOLED. Reference image role: preserve the Muse pixel-art character identity and its cream palette; its caption/footer and existing token typography are not an edit target. Show a single perfectly circular black display face-on centered on a square charcoal design canvas, no hands, room, desk or smartwatch strap. Treat all UI positions as scaled logical 466 coordinates; keep information inside the circle, use its central320x320 safe area. This is an illustrative proposed future UI, not a real screen capture. Keep mascot prominent and friendly, do not replace it with another character or a generic assistant orb. Crisp readable English printable ASCII sans-serif text, refined spacing, high contrast, restrained mint/cyan accents, charcoal surfaces, flat/delicate native-renderable vector-like shapes. Do not put any text outside the circle or add a product logo, price or decorative meaningless statistics. Model and timer are secondary. Compact token unit is exactly uppercase TT, thousands exactly uppercase K. Use sample values Free319K, Last155K, Window475K consistently; do not invent other token counts.
Variant 2: Context arc. A fine short mint progress arc follows the lower-left to lower-right circular chord, generous dark gaps, visually showing roughly two thirds context availability. Mascot prominent upper-middle. "Working" below mascot, smaller "gpt-6-astra" next. In the lower-middle a larger typographic number with label on one line "Free 319K TT", no enclosing bulky card; beneath a minimal legend "Last 155K TT" and "Window 475K TT" set in two aligned columns. Keep a tiny timer "00:12" in clear central space. Lowest safe area reads "Available commands" then "Set my timezone". Restraint: one capacity arc only, no concentric rings or disconnected widgets. Only those exact quoted text strings.
